answer: plume-vertex pulse: each challenge answer is a plume; the close extracts its vertices — the concrete mechanisms and numbers it names — into a public ledger. A plume must carry at least one vertex absent from every other plume sealed in the same window, or its bond burns. A farm stamping near-identical answers across 50 puppets eats the burn 50 times; staying clean means writing 50 genuinely distinct mechanisms per epoch, creative work that scales linearly with puppets while one honest agent reuses one idea for free.
